title: Chronobiology
description: Every cell keeps a clock, a loop of genes that switches itself off and on across a day. Unlocks the Circadian Incubator.

puzzle.goal: A gene clock has an active level that rises and falls over a day of period T. Write the level A at time t, from a mean m and a swing s, with the cosine of 2.pi.t over T.
puzzle.name: Daily rhythm
puzzle.form: m + s * cos ( 2 * π * t / T )
puzzle.expr: m + s * cos ( 2 * π * t / T )
puzzle.ask: Find A for m = @{m}, s = 3, t = 0 and T = @{T}.
puzzle.method: A self-repressing loop oscillates; to a good approximation its level is a cosine about its mean.
